description: Pages through a showcase's items in display order: id, kind, status, file name, the local path it was uploaded from, alt text, and categories. Use it to find item ids for update_items or tag_items, or photos that still need alt text (missingAlt: true). Up to 200 items per call; local paths only appear for files uploaded from this machine.

category.description: Only items in this category (name, slug, or id), e.g. "Kitchens".

kind.description: Only photos or only videos, e.g. "photo".

missingAlt.description: Only photos without alt text, e.g. true.

offset.description: nextOffset from a previous call, e.g. 50.

search.description: Case-insensitive text in the file name, local path, or alt text, e.g. "deck".

name: list_showcase_items
title: List showcase items
